description: DRC Systems India Limited, a software development company, engages in the provision of information technology (IT) and IT enabled services in India, the United Arab Emirates, and internationally. The company offers web development, mobile application development, digital learning / e-learning, digital commerce / e-commerce, content management system, UI/UX design services, digital marketing services, and QA engineering and testing services; digital transformation services, such as application modernization, digital process automation, enterprise resource planning, product and platform engineering, agile consulting, and resource augmentation services; cloud strategy and consulting, managed cloud, cloud orchestration, and cloud infrastructure management services. It also provides artificial intelligence and machine learning, blockchain development; analytics and insights, and AI-powered chatbot and virtual assistants development services, as well as project management tools and blockchain-powered document issuing platform. In addition, the company offers Economic Zone Management System, a cloud & SaaS-based solution with single integrated system providing real-time insights on customer service, compliance, operation, and management for free zone, business parks, logistics, and economic zone. It serves education, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, public sector, and BFSI sectors. The company was formerly known as DRC Systems India Private Limited. DRC Systems India Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Gandhinagar, India.
